columns.title: AI Weekly
columns.label: Industry & research briefings
columns.description: A weekly perspective on models, research, AI hardware, agents, open source, and the businesses shaping the field.

articles.title: AI 情报｜2026-11-16 ～ 2026-11-22
articles.description: GPT-6.2, Qwen4-Max, Neon, Inkling Mini, WeMM, KV quantization, vLLM, SGLang, RTX Spark, AMD NPU, ROCm and CPO. Task costs, state correctness and hardware conditions examined through primary sources.

articles.description: Fable, Gemini, Qwen, Inkling open weights, H3 Image, Rubin, EPD, NIXL, oMLX and edge inference. Speculation budgets, cache stability and state memory examined through primary sources.

articles.title: AI 情报｜2026-11-02 ～ 2026-11-08
articles.description: Inkling 2 Small, FP4 Attention, DARIC, HBC, Vera, SGLang, vLLM, MLX and agent workflows. Memory, numerical accuracy, latency and shipping status examined through primary sources.

articles.title: AI 情报｜2026-10-26 ～ 2026-11-01
articles.description: GPT-6.1 Terra, Gemini Carbon, Mistral Large 4, LFM3, GAAC, Mooncake, NIXL, MLX and AI industry results. Model capabilities, task costs and inference state examined through primary sources.

articles.title: AI 情报｜2026-10-18 ～ 2026-10-25
articles.description: DeepInfer, vLLM / SGLang, TorchTPU, MiniMax, Kimi, MLX, agent runtimes and AI infrastructure. A source-backed technical briefing with performance caveats and practical implications.

columns.title: AI Foundations
columns.label: From intuition to understanding
columns.description: Explore the ideas behind AI, from approachable fundamentals to implementation-level deep dives. Follow how methods evolved and understand the choices behind them.

articles.title: BatchNorm：训练时看一批图，部署时为什么能折叠进卷积？
articles.description: BatchNorm statistics, train/eval behavior and frozen convolution folding, with a real CNN correctness experiment, injected faults and weight-only INT8 diagnostics.

articles.title: Chunked Prefill：长 Prompt 怎样不挡住别人出字？
articles.description: Sarathi-Serve scheduling, causal KV semantics, token-budget arithmetic and the TTFT / inter-token tradeoff, with a reproducible correctness experiment.

articles.title: Tensor Parallel：为什么每层 Transformer 都要“开两次会”？
articles.description: Column and row parallelism, per-layer forward/backward collectives, ring byte accounting, GQA layouts and the different costs of prefill and decode.

articles.title: KV Cache 量化：为什么 Key 按通道，Value 按 Token？
articles.description: KIVI's asymmetric grouping, residual cache and complete memory ledger. Attention error, KVQuant, backend behavior and GPU/NPU decode costs explained.

articles.title: Online Softmax：为什么多算几次，反而能少读写显存？
articles.description: From stable normalization to blockwise attention: equations, worked examples, original paper figures, memory traffic and engineering limits.

columns.title: AI Lab
columns.label: Try it. Measure it. Question it.
columns.description: A place for clever tricks, hands-on experiments, and counterintuitive results. Explore what works, when it breaks, and why.

articles.title: 改动像素的方向，为什么比改动幅度更容易骗过分类器？
articles.description: Real handwritten digits, three trained classifiers and equal-budget gradient versus random perturbations. Reproducible FGSM, PGD, transfer and full classification metrics.

articles.title: 文本一模一样，分段编码为什么会换一串 Token？
articles.description: Real byte-level BPE experiments on text boundaries, equal-count ID changes, stable counterexamples, prefix-cache reuse and incremental Unicode decoding.

articles.title: Attention 热力图几乎反过来，模型输出为什么还能不变？
articles.description: Different attention maps with identical weighted outputs. A reproducible nullspace experiment, full-rank counterexamples and the debate over causal explanations.

articles.title: 旋转不改变计算，为什么 INT4 误差会变？
articles.description: A reproducible Hadamard experiment with an outlier case and a zero-error counterexample. QuaRot, SpinQuant and the limits of RMSNorm/RoPE invariance.

articles.title: 同加一个常数，为什么FP16的Softmax会变？
articles.description: A reproducible CPU experiment on representation loss, rounding and non-associativity. Includes Python code, measured results and clear limits.

columns.title: AI Surveys
columns.label: Mapping a field, connecting the ideas
columns.description: My explorations of AI research directions: how a field developed, how approaches compare, and which questions remain open.

articles.title: RNN 模型综述：从递归骨干到语言、语音、OCR、时序与视觉任务
articles.description: Classical gated RNNs, RWKV, xLSTM, state-space and delta backbones across language, speech, OCR, classification, detection, landmarks, segmentation, video and forecasting. 53 papers, 173 original figures and tables, five diagrams, frozen implementations and an actual 18-model CPU state and classification experiment.

articles.title: CNN 模型综述：从特征骨干到分类、检测、关键点与分割
articles.description: From LeNet and ResNet to modern CNNs, detection, human pose, facial landmarks, semantic and instance segmentation, OCR and reconstruction. 43 papers, 172 original figures and tables, four diagrams, frozen implementations and an actual layout and per-op runtime diagnostic.

articles.title: 文生图与图片编辑：怎样让人物、物体和画风保持一致
articles.description: DreamBooth-LoRA, PhotoMaker, identity adapters, reference routing, group portraits, story attributes and persistent editing. 34 studies, 162 original figures and tables, four diagrams, frozen implementations and an actual 64-input CLIP/DINO and pixel-preservation diagnostic.

articles.title: Over-Encoding 与 Engram：LLM 如何把局部模式交给可扩展记忆
articles.description: Input expansion, offline phrase networks, conditional memory, collisions, low-bit tables, writing and serving. 27 studies, 127 original figures and tables, eight diagrams, frozen implementations and an actual three-seed training and state-recovery diagnostic.

articles.title: LoRA：从低秩微调到训练动态、量化与多适配器部署
articles.description: Rank budgets, scaling, initialization, quantized merge order, composition and multi-adapter serving. 32 papers, 121 original figures and tables, seven diagrams and an actual three-seed training and recovery diagnostic.

articles.title: LLM 的 QAT 量化：让训练适应低位表示，从替代梯度到真实部署
articles.description: Surrogate gradients, distillation, efficient training, low-rank merge order, discrete optimization and FP4 deployment. 34 papers, 128 original figures and tables, six diagrams and an actual three-seed training/export experiment.

articles.title: LLM 的 PTQ 量化：从 INT8 到 2 bit，精度、误差补偿与真实推理
articles.description: Outliers, scaling, rotations, low-bit representations, calibration mismatch, KV cache and FP4. 29 papers, 148 original figures and tables, six diagrams, frozen implementations and a real Pythia numerical experiment.

articles.title: MoE 专家预取：提前知道谁会被激活，为什么仍可能等权重
articles.description: Expert prediction, prefetch timing, CPU fallback, graph slots and SSD routing. 23 papers, 111 original figures and tables, five diagrams, frozen implementation evidence and an actual CPU correctness experiment.

articles.title: Attention：从可学习对齐到长上下文计算系统
articles.description: From learned alignment and Transformer to linear attention, GQA, MLA, FlashAttention 1–4 and sparse serving. 22 papers, 88 original figures and tables, five diagrams and five reproducible CPU experiments.

articles.title: LLM 投机解码：从概率纠错到推理系统协同
articles.description: Exact rejection sampling, tree verification, feature and block drafting, from classic speculative decoding to EAGLE-4 and ForeSpark. 16 papers, 66 original figures, measured-code protocols and a reproducible probability experiment.

articles.title: ViT token 压缩：从删掉背景到保留任务信息
articles.description: Pruning, merging, learned resampling and adaptive depth, from visual encoders to dense tasks and VLM interfaces. 24 papers, 73 original figures, fixed implementations and a reproducible attention experiment.

articles.title: MoE 模型：从条件计算到系统协同
articles.description: From adaptive experts to sparse LLMs, latent routing and edge serving. A source-backed survey with 24 papers, 65 original figures, equations and a reproducible routing experiment.
